Joining the firm Oct. 16, 2026
Helen Gilbert joined Jenner & Block as a partner in San Francisco. The move was Oct. 14, 2026.

Gilbert spent more than 10 years at the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of California, where she served as chief of the National Security, Cyber, and Special Prosecutions Section. She supervised prosecutions involving national security, cybersecurity, trade secret theft, economic espionage and public corruption. Her experience also includes wire fraud, tax fraud, government program fraud and evaluating qui tam cases for potential criminal prosecution. In private practice, she represents clients in government investigations, white-collar criminal matters and corporate crises, including companies in the artificial intelligence, semiconductor, cybersecurity and advanced mobility industries.

Jenner & Block has 500 attorneys in 7 offices including San Francisco, Los Angeles, Century City. Among the law firm’s key practice areas are Appellate and Supreme Court; Investigations, Compliance and Defense, Media and Entertainment Litigation; Intellectual Property; Energy. The firm’s website is http://https//www.jenner.com/en
